r: bootc-install-print-configuration - Output JSON to stdout that contains the merged installation configuration as it may be relevant to calling processes using `install to-filesystem` that in particular want to discover the desired root filesystem type from the container image

Output JSON to stdout that contains the merged installation configuration as it may be relevant to calling processes using `install to-filesystem` that in particular want to discover the desired root filesystem type from the container image.

At the current time, the only output key is `root-fs-type` which is a string-valued filesystem name suitable for passing to `mkfs.$type`.
